protocol.status: Exploratory: all evaluation years were previously inspected; no fresh validation or parameter optimization
protocol.budget: Three diagnostic holding horizons on the existing 4h breakout; one independent daily trend strategy. Publish every result, no retuning or fallback presets in this experiment.
protocol.hypothesis: Daily channels and wider protective stops may reduce intraday whipsaw and let trend profits cover transaction costs. Fibonacci is not assumed to add value.

event_study.signal: Completed 4h close beyond the preceding 20-bar high/low
event_study.exit: Open at entry time plus horizon, directional slippage; no stops in diagnostic labels
event_study.unit: Net price PnL including actual funding, divided by 2 signal ATR plus roundtrip costs and 0.25 ATR gap reserve
event_study.controls: Nonbreakout closes, same calendar quarter and quintile of trailing ATR/price; measure each control in the event direction
event_study.uncertainty: 28-day calendar block bootstrap of paired event excess, 2000 draws, seed 20261010
event_study.overlap: Drop labels crossing evaluation boundaries; overlapping events are dependent and never counted as portfolio trades
event_study.selection: Diagnostic only: does not select or retune the daily strategy

strategy.name: macro_daily_55_20
strategy.entry: Market next 5m open after completed UTC daily close beyond the prior 55-day channel, while flat
strategy.exit: Initial 3 daily ATR stop, tightened only at subsequent daily closes toward the completed 20-day opposite channel one tick outside

execution.funding: Actual Binance rates on carried quantity, with 5m opening traded price as mark proxy
execution.entry_candle: Protective stop active immediately; gap stop at adverse opening price
execution.capital: Independent continuous account for each multi-year comparison, no within-period resets

protocol.publication: Only a candidate passing these exploratory comparisons proceeds to a Pine prototype; it remains unverified prospectively and natively. Failed results are published without relaxing gates. No Bitunix sample is used because the sampled execution pages were inconsistent.

uncertainty.method: resample entire 28-day calendar clusters of paired labels
uncertainty.caveat: Exploratory interval; overlapping labels, reuse and three horizon comparisons remain. Not adjusted significance.

diagnostics.caveat: No stop, no account sizing, overlapping future labels: these are diagnostic returns, not portfolio trades. Control matching uses full quarter data retrospectively; it is never a live signal.
